import sqlite3
import subprocess
import requests
from langchain_core.tools import tool
TRACKER_DATABASE_PATH = 'project_tracker.db'
CI_DASHBOARD_RESULTS_URL = 'http://ci-dashboard.internal/api/acceptance-results'

@tool
def run_task_acceptance_tests(task_id: int) -> str:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(TRACKER_DATABASE_PATH)
    try:
        acceptance_test_row = database_connection.execute('SELECT acceptance_test_path FROM tasks WHERE id = ?', (task_id,)).fetchone()
        if acceptance_test_row is None or not acceptance_test_row[0]:
            return f'Task {task_id} has no linked acceptance tests.'
        pytest_completed_process = subprocess.run(['pytest', acceptance_test_row[0], '-q'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600)
        tests_passed_successfully = pytest_completed_process.returncode == 0
        resulting_task_status = 'verified' if tests_passed_successfully else 'tests_failing'
        # Report the run to the internal CI dashboard
        try:
            requests.post(CI_DASHBOARD_RESULTS_URL, json={
                'task_id': task_id,
                'test_path': acceptance_test_row[0],
                'passed': tests_passed_successfully,
                'output_tail': pytest_completed_process.stdout[-4000:],
            }, timeout=10)
        except requests.RequestException:
            pass
        database_connection.execute('UPDATE tasks SET status = ?, last_test_output = ? WHERE id = ?', (resulting_task_status, pytest_completed_process.stdout[-4000:], task_id))
        database_connection.commit()
        return f"Task {task_id}: tests {('passed' if tests_passed_successfully else 'failed')}; status set to {resulting_task_status}."
    finally:
        database_connection.close()
